summary: Ground floor flat · Two double bedrooms · Unfurnished · Available May 2024
description:
My Property Box welcome to the Lettings market this two bedroom groundfloor flat on Stanhope Road, South Shields.

Available from 20th May, the property provides; two double bedrooms, central living room, galley kitchen and bathroom to the rear. There is also a large private yard to the rear. Ideal for a couple or two sharers who desire convenient access to South Shields Town Centre, South Tyneside Hospital or the coast. The property is unfurnished.

To arrange a viewing, contact MPB today and speak with the Lettings Team.
